data.name: Blackroot: Medieval Survival
data.detailed_description:
Blackroot - Medieval Survival is a brutal and immersive survival game set in a cursed medieval world where the dead do not rest. After a mysterious plague sweeps across the land, the once-prosperous kingdom falls into chaos. The forests whisper with danger, the villages lie in ruin, and something dark stirs beneath the earth.

As a lone survivor, you must gather resources, craft tools, and build shelter while fending off hunger, disease, and relentless undead creatures. Explore eerie ruins, uncover ancient secrets, and fight to reclaim what remains of humanity. Every decision matters in a world where life is fragile and death walks the land.

Key Features:

  • Medieval survival – survive in a brutal world ravaged by plague and collapse.

  • Medieval zombies – face hordes of infected roaming through abandoned villages and dark forests.

  • Battles against knights – fight heavily armed knights sent to eliminate survivors and stop the spread of the plague.

  • Crafting and medieval equipment – forge melee weapons, armor, and survival tools using old-world techniques.

  • Realistic resource management – gather food, water, and materials to stay alive.

  • Character progression – develop survival, combat, and crafting skills.

  • Open, dynamic world – explore a medieval landscape filled with secrets and dangers.

  • Day and night cycle, dynamic weather – adapt to changing conditions and increased nighttime threats.

  • Storytelling through exploration – uncover the grim fate of a world consumed by the black plague.

  • Atmospheric graphics and grim mood – a dark, haunting medieval world full of tension and dread.

Will you survive the darkness, or become one of the lost souls consumed by Blackroot?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: INTEL CORE I5-8400 or AMD RYZEN 3 3300X
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 3GB or AMD Radeon RX 570 4GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:

  • Processor: INTEL CORE I7-8700K or AMD RYZEN 5 3600X
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 1080Ti or AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 MB available space
